"use strict";
self["rspackHotUpdate"]("main", {
"./loader.js"(module, __webpack_exports__, __webpack_require__) {
__webpack_require__.r(__webpack_exports__);
__webpack_require__.d(__webpack_exports__, {
  load: () => (load),
  loadAgain: () => (loadAgain)
});
// Moving the imports must not change the identity of the named group.
const load = () => __webpack_require__.e(/* import() | page */ "page").then(__webpack_require__.bind(__webpack_require__, "./page.js"));
const loadAgain = () => __webpack_require__.e(/* import() | page */ "page").then(__webpack_require__.bind(__webpack_require__, "./page.js"));
module.hot.accept();


},

},function(__webpack_require__) {
// webpack/runtime/get_full_hash
(() => {
__webpack_require__.h = () => ("CURRENT_HASH")
})();
// webpack/runtime/chunk_group_map
(() => {
((groups) => {
	var map = __webpack_require__.hmrS_chunkGroups = __webpack_require__.hmrS_chunkGroups || Object.create(null);
	
	Object.keys(groups).forEach((chunkId) => {
		if (groups[chunkId] === null) delete map[chunkId];
		else map[chunkId] = groups[chunkId];
	});
})({"page":["shared"]});


})();

}
);
